steps.what: Verify study activity sources and capture required record updates
Copy verified updates into case report, dispensation or regulatory record drafts
Reconcile updates and maintain the approved study records with source traceability

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} study-record imports from coordinator-verified updates. Keep source interpretation, reconciliation and final recording approval human, with references retained in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified activity values may be copied into several required records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports can stage mapped values for review.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting source evidence and preserve correction history.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a record does not represent the activity correctly.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry; unchanged record stewardship and clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Castor Catalyst proposes case report values from source documents for human approval; this supports supervised entry, not clinical interpretation or autonomous drug records.
Model knowledge: the proposed import saving is a local scenario, conditional on duplicate entry being present.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining activity records, excluding clinical procedures, actual drug dispensing and separate document authorship. {OTHER} means governed clinical study records system.

In s1 the coordinator produces study/subject reference, activity date, record type, target field, verified value, units, source version and correction reason. Source capture and manual extraction retain the full 35%. Dispensing staff produce actual dispensation evidence after dispensing and before this capture; no free dispensed-drug flag is assumed.
s2 stages only mapped s1 values; missing or conflicting values return to manual reconciliation in s3. Test native forms and imports before custom code.
Record copying overlapping documentation task 15595 must have one owner in roll-up. Original source production is unchanged and gains no saving.
unknowns: Existing entry automation and source record formats
research_questions: How much duplicate entry remains after source verification and reconciliation?

approvals.approved_version: Exact study, subject, target records, staged values, source references and correction history checked before commit; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+30=65; gross=35, incremental=8, net=27. Range 0-10 allows existing prefilling or unresolved source conflicts to consume much of the copying gain; dispensing and clinical work stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify and resolve protocol problems with investigators

steps.what: Identify protocol problems and establish supporting facts and subject implications
Inform investigators of problems and assist in resolving or revising the protocol

tasks.design: Keep problem recognition and investigator discussion human, supported by the current protocol in {DOCS}. The task supplies no separate routine drafting baseline to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: A protocol problem must be understood in its actual study and subject context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support fact checking; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish implementation error from a flaw requiring protocol revision.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an important concern and communicate it clearly to the responsible investigator.
tasks.altitude: Problem escalation duties and investigator revision authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recognising protocol problems and negotiating resolution remain contextual judgement and conversation; no measured saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator identification, escalation and resolution assistance, excluding investigator protocol approval and urgent clinical action.

The coordinator captures protocol revision, observed event, source, uncertainty and potential implication in s1. Investigator responses arise during s2 before a resolution contribution is completed; clarification remains within its full 60%. No free protocol-deviation code is assumed.
Test native document access before custom tooling; no new configuration is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing escalation process remains unchanged; revisions require existing investigator and study governance approval outside this task.
unknowns: Escalation procedure and typical protocol concerns
research_questions: Is any repeatable issue-register administration distinct from actual problem resolution?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, incremental=0; net=0. Simple clarifications and protocol revision concerns retain recognition and resolution time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review proposed study protocols and risks

steps.what: Review proposed study protocols for sample collection, data management and subject risks

tasks.design: Keep protocol review and risk interpretation with the coordinator and responsible specialists. {DOCS} holds the proposed plans and evidence; no generated completeness score substitutes for reading the protocol.
tasks.previous_blocker: Risk can arise from interactions between procedures and data handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing source access supports review; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise unstated assumptions and plausible harms absent from a checklist.
tasks.human_edge: Question whether a procedure is workable and appropriate for subjects.
tasks.altitude: Review duties and formal study approval authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-document summarisation does not establish clinical protocol safety; no removable clerical baseline is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator review findings, excluding investigator approval, ethics review and actual sample collection.

The protocol author supplies the proposal and linked plans before review. The coordinator elicits and records procedure details, data flows, source evidence and unresolved risks within s1; missing plans require manual clarification. No free complete-plan or low-risk flag is assumed.
Test native document comparison before custom tools; none is added.
Incremental upkeep is zero because tools and review process remain unchanged.
unknowns: Protocol complexity and required specialist input
research_questions: Is mechanical document comparison a separate observed activity after substantive risk review?

already_counted.description: Source reading, risk interpretation and clarification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0, net=0. Familiar and novel protocols retain substantive reading and risk assessment; no automatic safety finding is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on clinical study reports and presentations

steps.what: Collaborate with investigators to establish procedures, results and conclusions for reporting
Prepare presentation or report text from the agreed study evidence

loop.purpose: Draft an explanation of agreed study findings
loop.input: Source-linked procedures, results, investigator conclusions and audience requirements
loop.output: Draft with traceable figures and explicit limitations
loop.check: Coordinator compares population, endpoints, causal wording and uncertainty with investigator-approved interpretations and original results
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; changed conclusions return to investigator discussion
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific scientific explanations require interpretation beyond a fixed layout

steps.what: Review the contribution with investigators and resolve report meaning changes

tasks.design: Draft a report or presentation in {DOCS} from an investigator-discussed evidence brief. Keep collaboration, conclusions and final review human; no automatic publication or external submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: First-draft writing is mixed with scientific agreement and review.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can express agreed conclusions for review.
tasks.still_hard: Avoid overstating findings or omitting limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when wording changes what the study supports.
tasks.altitude: Less initial writing, unchanged scientific collaboration and publication authority.

reach.task: Explain clinical study findings to a wider audience

evidence.claim: The digest's Novo Nordisk case describes clinical study report drafting from expert-approved text with human approval; its vendor-reported reduction is not transferred to this whole collaboration task.
Model knowledge: the local writing and review savings are unmeasured scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator collaboration and preparation, excluding original analysis, investigator publication approval and live presentation delivery.

Investigators produce their interpretations during s1 before the brief is complete. The coordinator captures study version, population, endpoints, result values, uncertainty, agreed conclusions and source references within its full 40%; missing interpretation returns to human discussion.
Investigator responses to the completed draft arise during s3 before the contribution is finalised; coordinator clarification is retained in the full 25%. No free approved-conclusion flag is assumed.
Test native templates before custom tools. This report contribution and documentation task 15595 must be assigned once when they refer to the same report; investigator review is unchanged.
unknowns: Report mix, existing templates and investigator review effort
research_questions: Does collaborative meaning review leave a net first-draft saving?

already_counted.description: Draft scientific meaning review and correction

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+24.5+25=89.5; gross=10.5, incremental=5, net=5.5. Range 0-2 allows complex findings and investigator corrections to consume most drafting gains; collaboration and scientific decisions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native record reuse and bounded report drafting support continued human protocol and evidence judgement.
reach: Explain study record discrepancies and protocol risks to scientific management.
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator with traceable records and reporting support who retains responsibility for study meaning and escalation.
